title: Planner: fit an ordered queue to a time window (failing test first)
goal: An approvable queue that ends before 07:00
acceptance: Owner request 2026-11-26 in the consumer session (𖣂 nerv): "maybe useful to suggest, planning for nights run"; nerv runs campaigns through tools/gauntlet.mjs and is the first consumer.

A committed failing test first, then a planner: window default 01:00-07:00, stages strictly sequential (never two model runs at once), a gap for unloading and loading between stages, a stage skipped with its reason when its estimate would end after the window, the rest of the queue still considered
Fixtures: everything fits, last stage dropped, window already past, a chain where one stage depends on the previous (campaign, then planner pack, then image, then extra packs)
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git; reports and plans hold no personal text.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
